_comment: What the build pills on the product pages report. Refresh with `npm run builds:refresh`.
type ado    — needs ADO_PAT (Build: Read). Replace `definition` with the pipeline's exact name.
type github — public repos need no token; GITHUB_TOKEN raises the rate limit.
type local  — runs the command here and records the exit status. Used while the pipelines are private.
_pending: Azure DevOps (org dotproperties, project 'Dot Properties') serves only the generic
'set up now' badge anonymously, so real pipeline status needs either ADO_PAT set here
or Project Settings -> Settings -> anonymous badge access enabled. Swap the Rental.Cloud
"definition": "<pipeline name>"} once one of those is in place.
GitHub Actions entries can replace the Mediashare and Entraprise locals once
bluecollardev/mediashare and bluecollardev/rental-cloud-app exist with workflows.

Deployment pipelines has no check: Deployments/templates/deploy-api-local-Report.yml does not parse (a '- pwsh:' step at line 145 sits outside the deployment job), so a repo-wide YAML check would report red on a template nothing references.
